applies_why: The judge uses the text's failure to name whose body is the channel as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the kind of single-verse silence ground the rule governs.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
why: The judge grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the absence of an explicit naming rather than on exhibited chain support, which K-S2 forbids.
